sloka: भरतस्य तु तस्य आज्ञाम् प्रतिगृह्य प्रहर्षितः ।रथम् गृहीत्वा प्रययौ युक्तम् परम वाजिभिः ॥२-८२-२८॥
transliteration: bharatasya tu tasya ājñām pratigṛhya praharṣitaḥ ।ratham gṛhītvā prayayau yuktam parama vājibhiḥ ॥2-82-28॥

translations.english: He (Sumantra) received the command of Bharata in great delight and set out with a chariot harnessed with excellent horses.
